out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: beef ragu (93F after 2.5 hours)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Person in charge discarded ragu.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: blanched broccolini (46F), caramelized onion (48F) in 3 door prep unit on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge discarded items.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. Observed mixed juices stored in ice bin at bar at the same time consumable ice was being stored with no divider or separation.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. Person in charge removed juices and discarded ice.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: ice scoop in ice machine and ice bins at bar stored with handle in contact with consumable ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge removed scoops and discarded ice.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: PIC Duties, Train Employees on Food Safety
violations.observation: Employees are not properly trained in food safety, including food allergy awareness, cooking temperatures, thermometer calibration temperatures, receiving temperatures, cooling parameters, hand washing procedures to include where, when, and how, glove usage, etc as it relates to their assigned duties.
violations.corrective_action: The Person in Charge or certified food manager shall train all his/her employees in food safety, including allergy awareness, as it relates to their assigned duties. EHS PROVIDED IN EMAIL MANY FACT SHEETS FOR STAFF TO REVIEW BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the 2025 Health Department Food Establishment permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS REMINDED STAFF TO LOCATE AND POST THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT AND OTHER COUNTY PERMITS IN A VISIBLE LOCATION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department discussed and reviewed handouts and resource information.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information emailed at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS EMAILED MANAGEMENT THE EMPLOYEE ILLNESS REPORTING AGREEMENT IN BOTH ENGLISH AND SPANISH. ALL STAFF ARE REQUIRED TO READ, SIGN, AND ACKNOWLEDGE THE POLICY. PROVIDE SIGNED COPIES AT THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS EMAILED MANAGEMENT THE WRITTEN VOMITING AND DIARRHEA POLICY. ENSURE STAFF ARE TRAINED ON THE POLICY AND MANAGEMENT PROVIDES THE ITEMS NECESSARY FOR PROPER CLEAN UP BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Food employee(s) failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after changing tasks, before putting on new, clean gloves, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS PROVIDED A FACT SHEET ON HAND WASHING. ENSURE STAFF ARE PRACTICING PROPER HAND WASHING PROCEDURES AT ALL TIMES AND IT IS DEMONSTRATED BY STAFF DURING THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed the hot water at the cold dessert station hand sink only reaching a temperature of 85-88f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO GET THE HOT WATER CONSISTENT AT 100F FOR ALL/ANY HAND SINKS AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. OWNER /CALLED/TEXTED FOR SERVICE.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO INSTALL PAPER TOWEL DISPENSERS AND PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS AT ALL HAND SINKS. MANAGEMENT WILL PROVIDE PAPER TOWELS TODAY AND ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE PRE-OCCUPANCY INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL HAND SINKS IN THE KITCHEN AND BAR AREAS SHALL BE SUPPLIED WITH SOAP. MANAGEMENT WILL PROVIDE SOAP TODAY AND WILL ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. THIS IS A REPEAT FROM THE PRE-OCCUPANCY INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO PROVIDE HAND WASHING SIGNAGE AT ALL HAND SINKS IN THE KITCHEN, BAR, AND RESTROOMS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION FROM THE PRE-OCCUPANCY INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) RAW BEEF STORED ON A SHELF ABOVE SAUCES INSIDE THE ATOSA 2DOOR PREP TOP UNIT AT THE COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT THAT ALL RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS LIKE EGGS, PORK, SEAFOOD, BEEF, AND POULTRY STALL BE STORED BELOW AND SEPARATED FROM SAUCES, VEGETABLES, COOKED FOODS, ETC. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Proper cooking time and temperatures

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: 1) CHICKEN WINGS. Manager described that the raw chicken wings are received, seasoned, cooked to 145f, cooled down, and then re-cooked for immediate service.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO CEASE THIS PROCESS AS NO LOGS ARE PROVIDED FOR A NON-CONTINUOUS COOK PROCESS. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO FULLY COOK THE CHICKEN WINGS THE FIRST TIME TO AN INTERNAL TEMPERATURE O F 165F BEFORE COOLING THEM DOWN.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: 1) STEAKS, 2) TUNA, 3) BURGERS, 4) CAESAR SALAD DRESSING, 5) TARTAR AND/OR CARPACCIO.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS DISCUSSED HOW THE FULL CONSUMER ADVISORY SHALL BE PRESENTED ON THE MENU. THE INDIVIDUAL FOOD ITEM THAT IS ALLOWED TO BE UNDERCOOKED BY THE CUSTOMER SHALL BE ASTERISKED (*). THEN A STATEMENT AT THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU SHALL SAY “THIS ITEM MAY CONTAIN RAW OR UNDERCOOKED INGREDIENTS. CONSUMING RAW OR UNDERCOOKED BEEF, SEAFOOD, AND EGGS MAY INCREASE YOUR RISK OF FOODBORNE ILLNESS.” EHS REQUESTED THE MENUS BE CHANGED AND REVIEWED BEFORE PRINTING. OWNER TOOK NOTES ON HOW TO CHANGE THE MENUS AND WILL GET THE DRAFT TO THE EHS BY 12/23/2025 AND ENSURE NEW MENUS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE FOLLOW UP DATE OF 12/30/2025.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed spray bottles of chemicals at the cook line with food and above the food prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO TRAIN STAFF TO USE CHEMICALS AS NEEDED AND THEN TO STORE THEM IN ONE DESIGNATED LOCATION BELOW AND AWAY FROM FOOD, CLEAN EQUIPMENT/UTENSILS, CLEAN LINENS, SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS, ETC. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND TRAINING TO STAFF AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Pasteurized eggs used where required

violations.title: Pasteurized eggs substituted for raw eggs in uncooked, egg-based recipes
violations.observation: Raw shell eggs are used in the preparation of the following ready-to-eat foods without subsequent full cooking: 1) HOMEMADE CAESAR SALAD DRESSING.
violations.corrective_action: Pasteurized eggs or egg products shall be substituted for raw eggs in the preparation of foods such as Caesar salad, hollandaise, or Bearnaise sauce, mayonnaise, meringue, eggnog, ice cream, and egg fortified beverages and recipes that where egg ingredient is not fully cooked and when the consumer is not informed by a disclosure and reminder statement. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER AND OWNER TO PROVIDE A CONSUMER ADVISORY ON THE MENU FOR THE HOMEMADE CAESAR SALAD DRESSING UNLESS THE CHEF SWITCHES AND USES ONLY PASTEURIZED EGGS IN THE RECIPE. OWNER WILL CHANGE THE MENU AND PUT ON A CONSUMER ADVISORY.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed commercially vacuum packaged seafood being thawed in the bag. The bags were not cut open.
violations.corrective_action: EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO TRAIN STAFF TO CUT OPEN THE VACUUM PACKAGED BAGS FOR SEAFOOD BEFORE THAWING. BAGS WERE CUT OPEN AND SEAFOOD PLACED ON A SHEET PAN FOR REFRIGERATOR THAWING.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: 1) SOME SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF CONDIMENTS, SAUCES, WATER, OIL, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE ALL WORKING CONTAINERS AND BOTTLES OF FOODS ARE LABELED AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor in the kitchen areas and bar area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO ORDER NSF APPROVED DUNNAGE RACKS AS NEEDED TO ENSURE NOTHING IS DIRECTLY STORED ON THE FLOOR. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT STAFF ARE NOT ALLOWED TO WEAR ANY JEWELRY TO INCLUDE WATCHES, RINGS, SMART WATCHES, ETC. ONLY JEWELRY ALLOWED IS A FLAT WEDDING BAND. ENSURE TRAINING AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 1) ICE SCOOPS FOUND LYING IN THE ICE MACHINE(S) AND ICE BINS.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER THAT ALL FOOD BEING DISPENSED USING A FOOD SCOOP SHALL HAVE A HANDLE THAT SITS UP, OUT OF THE FOOD AT ALL TIMES. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils Self-Draining Position/Covered/Inverted
violations.observation: Clean mixing bowls (all sizes) were observed stored with the food-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored in a self-draining position that allows air drying and covered/inverted. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER THAT ALL CLEANED AND SANITIZED EQUIPMENT AND UTENSILS IN STORAGE SHALL BE INVERTED. ENSURE TRAINING TO STAFF AND CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. TOWN KITCHEN & BAR (Inspection Date: 12/16/2025) Page 4 of 6

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No high registering thermometer is available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. OWNER INDICATED HE HAD ORDERED THE HIGH REGISTERING THERMOMETER. ENSURE IT IS RECEIVED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. THIS DEVICE IS DESIGNED TO MEASURE THE FINAL SURFACE TEMPERATURE FOR THE HEAT SANITIZING DISH MACHINE IN THE KITCHEN. IT ALSO IDENTIFIES HOW MANY TIMES IT WILL TAKE FOR THE UNIT TO ACHIEVE THAT FINAL SURFACE TEMPERATURE REQUIREMENT OF 160F.

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions for the BAR CHEMICAL DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: EHS DISCUSSED WITH THE OWNER THAT HE WILL NEED THE BLEACH (CHLORINE) TEST KIT FOR THE BAR DISH MACHINE UNLESS HE REMOVES IT OR INSTALLS A THIRD TANKLESS WATER HEATER DUE TO LACK OF CAPACITY FOR HOT WATER AS DISCUSSED IN EMAIL WITH THE PLAN REVIEWER ON 11/20/2025 at 4:14pm.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: Observed only 2 Noritz tankless water heaters and 2 dish machines (one kitchen and one bar).
violations.corrective_action: EHS VERIFIED THERE IS A HOT WATER DEMAND ISSUE. THE OWNER AS PROVIDED IN EMAIL DATED 11/20/2025 AT 4:14PM HAS STATED HE WILL DISCONNECT THE BAR DISH MACHINE AND INSTALL A THIRD TANKLESS WATER HEATER. ENSURE PROPER PERMITS ARE PULLED FROM THE COUNTY FOR THE INSTALLATION OF THE THIRD TANKLESS WATER HEATER OR REMOVE THE BAR DISH MACHINE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Water Pressure Meets Facility Demands
violations.observation: Hot water under insufficient or inadequate pressure was found to serve the following equipment: 1) COLD DESSERT STATION HAND SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Water under pressure shall be provided to all fixtures, equipment, and nonfood equipment that are required to use water. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO FIX THE HOT WATER PRESSURE BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. OWNER PUT IN A REQUEST VIA TEXT DURING THE INSPECTION. TOWN KITCHEN & BAR (Inspection Date: 12/16/2025) Page 3 of 6

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved “splitter” on the mop sink and system is under constant pressure.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS HAD THE OWNER TAKE A PICTURE OF THE APPROVED PRESSURE BLEED VALVE AND OWNER SENT THE INFORMATION TO HIS LICENSED PLUMBER/CONTRACTOR. ENSURE THE HOT WATER AT THE MOP SINK DOES NOT GET ABOVE 120F. ENSURE CORRECTION AND INSTALLATION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP. TOWN KITCHEN & BAR (Inspection Date: 12/16/2025) Page 2 of 6

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Observed both restroom doors not provided with self-closing hinges.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER TO INSTALL SELF-CLOSING DOOR HINGES ON BOTH RESTROOM DOORS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent or underneath some hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE ALL HAND SINKS HAVE TRASH CANS ADJACENT OR UNDERNEATH ALL HAND SINKS AS NEEDED BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps, holes, and/or missing ceiling panels in the kitchen areas around piping, ansul system, water heaters plumbing, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER THAT THE GAPS, HOLES SHALL BE SEALED TO PREVENT ANY ENTRY OF INSECTS AND RODENTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED THE OWNER/MANAGER TO ENSURE WET MOPS ARE RINSED AND HUNG TO ALLOW AIR DRYING. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.
